Duration of each Zeal stack before it expires
Champion level at which Aflame (on-attack fire wave) unlocks
Champion level at which Transcendent (permanent max Zeal stacks) unlocks

values.quote: {{pplevel|20+3*(x-1)|11+x-1|formula=20 + 3 for every  level starting from level 11|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 10% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}}

mechanics.claim: Zeal stacks are generated on-attack, refresh their duration on each subsequent attack, and are all lost together when they expire.
mechanics.quote: generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Zeal'' for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and stacking up to 5 times

mechanics.claim: If Kayle is still in her attack animation when Zeal would expire, she gets 0.5 extra seconds to refresh/stack it.
mechanics.quote: If '''Kayle''' is in her attack animation after the stacks expire, she gains another {{fd|0.5}} seconds to refresh/stack

mechanics.claim: The Aflame fire wave only triggers on basic attacks while Kayle is Exalted (at max Zeal stacks), starting at level 11.
mechanics.quote: While '''Kayle''' is ''Exalted'', her basic attacks {{tip|on-attack}} also launch a ''wave'' of fire forward

mechanics.claim: The fire wave is affected by critical strike modifiers.
mechanics.quote: The ''wave'' is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.

mechanics.claim: The fire wave shares a cast instance with the triggering attack but is still counted as two separate damage instances.
mechanics.quote: Keep in mind that it's still two damage instances.

mechanics.claim: From level 16 (Transcendent), Kayle permanently has the full Zealous effect (always at max Zeal stacks) instead of needing to build stacks.
mechanics.quote: permanently gains the full effects of ''Zealous''
